name: pelican-mcp
description: MCP server for the Pelican Panel Application and Client APIs (admin + live server control).
long_description: Manage Pelican users, servers, nodes, eggs, roles, plugins, mounts, database hosts, and server databases (Application API), and control running servers with power signals, console commands, status, files, and backups (Client API). Includes 165 tools, 2 workflow prompts, and 2 resources covering both API trees. Targets Pelican Panel (https://pelican.dev), a fork of Pterodactyl.

panel_url.title: Panel URL
panel_url.description: Base URL of your Pelican panel (no trailing slash).

panel_token.title: Application API Key
panel_token.description: Pelican Application API key (usually starts with 'papp_'). Backs the admin pelican_app_* / pelican_ai_* tools. Optional if a Client API key is provided.

panel_client_token.title: Client (Account) API Key
panel_client_token.description: Pelican Account API key (usually starts with 'pacc_'). Backs the pelican_client_* tools (power, console command, status, files, backups). Optional if an Application API key is provided. At least one key is required.
